name: Taiwanese Metro and TR Pack
author: MaxCheng95
description:
This pack contains various metro and commuter trains used in Taiwan, including Taipei, New Taipei, Taoyuan, Taichung, Kaohsiung, and Taiwan Railway commuter trains.

Taipei Metro C321, C341, C371, C381, CR381A C610, Alstom Metropolis VAL256, Innovia 256

New Taipei Metro Sanying Line EMU, Danhai/Anking LRV

Taoyuan Metro 1000 series, 2000 series, Green Line EMU

Taichung Metro Green Line EMU

Kaohsiung Metro High Capacity EMU, CAF Urbos 3/Alstom Citadis X-05

Taiwan Railways EMU500, EMU700, EMU800, EMU900 PP Tze-Chiang EMU3000 New Tze-Chiang TEMU1000 Taroko, TEMU2000 Puyuma DR1000
